History:
59-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2022, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hyperlipidemia, hypothyroidism.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 37 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with moderate disease activity, CDAI 15.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
